args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
Bumps the pinned `fastjson` dependency from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affects `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`. Fixed in `2.9.4` (2.x line) and `3.1.0`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: passed.

No other changes.
